signature.note: Does NOT enter the `size` stage. The planner accepts compute_kernel_config and never reads an attribute of it: the only live occurrence in the whole 2585-line planner is `config=compute_kernel_config,  # passed through unmodified` (rms_norm_program_descriptor.py:2559). No CB page count, page size, depth, block-rows solve or footprint term is a function of the config, and fp32_dest_acc_en changes no CB's page format -- every CB derives its format from the dtype of the tensor it carries, and cb_row_stat is fp32 in both modes (see audits.page_format_vs_dest_width). The DEST-width consumers (PASS_B_BLK, COMBINE_DEST_BATCH) are computed IN THE KERNEL from the device-side constant ckl::DEST_AUTO_LIMIT (8 lanes at fp32_dest_acc_en=False, 4 at True), not by any host sizing computation.

A non-None program_config is therefore silently ignored rather than refused, which the docstring ('reserved; ignored when None') does not say.

regimes.selected_when: input memory_layout == INTERLEAVED, or layout == ROW_MAJOR with a HEIGHT shard / interleaved, or in_ml == HEIGHT_SHARDED and shard_w_tiles != Wt (the shard does not span the full padded width), or the L1 bail-out (force_rows) from a shard plan; also the ragged-width + partial-W bail-out
regimes.block: block_rows tile-rows x wt_chunk width tiles, split off the independent `row` axis by split_work_to_cores(full grid, row_wise=True)
regimes.data_movement: x once from DRAM (twice under STREAM), out once to DRAM, gamma once per core (a broadcast operand replicated across num_cores DRAM reads). Above the DRAM minimum by (num_cores-1) whole-gamma reads.
regimes.bigger_block_buys: fewer LLK inits / format reconfigs / CB handshakes per tile-row; fewer reader barriers (transaction granularity is wt_chunk tiles)
regimes.source: rms_norm_program_descriptor.py:1416 (_plan_rows), dispatched at rms_norm_program_descriptor.py:1630-1633 (interleaved / ROW_MAJOR / force_rows), rms_norm_program_descriptor.py:1648-1651 (HEIGHT shard with shard_w_tiles != Wt) and rms_norm_program_descriptor.py:1683-1686 (ragged width tail + partial W)

regimes.selected_when: layout == TILE and input memory_layout == HEIGHT_SHARDED and shard_w_tiles == Wt
regimes.block: the whole resident shard row-slice: block_rows x Wt, block_rows solved against L1
regimes.data_movement: x: ZERO DRAM crossings (cb_input_tiles aliases the resident L1 shard); out: zero when the output shard spec matches the input's; gamma once per core. Below the stated DRAM minimum because the input never crosses DRAM inside the op.
regimes.bigger_block_buys: same fixed costs as SCHEME_ROWS; no regime-added term (no cross-core traffic)

regimes.selected_when: layout == TILE and memory_layout in (WIDTH_SHARDED, BLOCK_SHARDED) and not (ragged width tail and W non-tile-aligned); OR memory_layout == INTERLEAVED, layout == TILE, Wt > 1 and _resolve_width_split returns gw > 1
regimes.block: block_rows x wt_per_core (the shard's width slice, or Wt // gw), block_rows capped at TILE_DIM by the compact partial's column count
regimes.data_movement: sharded: x and out ZERO DRAM crossings; interleaved split: x once, out once. Both add cross-core traffic: per row-block round, (group_size-1) unicast 4 kB fp32 tiles into the root plus one multicast of one 4 kB fp32 tile to group_size-1 receivers (tree path adds one hop).
regimes.bigger_block_buys: fewer combine ROUNDS (rounds = ceil(rows_per_core / block_rows)); each round is a full gather + fold + finalize + multicast rendezvous

regimes.selected_when: layout == ROW_MAJOR and input memory_layout in (WIDTH_SHARDED, BLOCK_SHARDED)
regimes.block: block_rows x wt_chunk, where wt_chunk is the WIDEST global tile span any core's band touches; extents read off the shard spec, not solved
regimes.data_movement: x: ZERO DRAM crossings, staged core-locally out of this core's own resident RM shard into the tilize ring; out written back to the local shard when band_out_local, else through the accessor. Same cross-core combine as SCHEME_SHARD_W.
regimes.bigger_block_buys: same as SCHEME_SHARD_W; additionally, a band that fills its tile columns and matches the shard stride collapses a per-stick staging read into one wide transfer

regimes.selected_when: x_resident and num_w_chunks == 1 -- the whole per-core width slice fits L1 at a depth from CB_DEPTH_CANDIDATES
regimes.block: block_rows x wt_per_core, one chunk
regimes.data_movement: x once from DRAM, gamma once per core
regimes.bigger_block_buys: amortizes inits/handshakes across more tile-rows

regimes.selected_when: not RESIDENT, and one WHOLE tile-row of x plus the whole row of gamma fits (held), with the derived CBs chunked; gated on max_rows_per_core >= ROW_RESIDENT_MIN_ROWS_PER_CORE only when it forces a shallower depth than STREAM would use
regimes.block: 1 x wt_chunk, with cb_input_tiles / cb_gamma_tiles spanning the whole tile-row (x_hold_wt = wt_per_core) and indexed at a TileOffset
regimes.data_movement: x once, gamma once per core -- identical to RESIDENT; strictly fewer DRAM bytes than STREAM at the same chunk count
regimes.bigger_block_buys: block_rows is pinned to 1 here; a coarser wt_chunk reduces the per-chunk helper-call count and the pass-B chunk loop trip count

knobs.name: CB_RM_STAGE_DEPTH
knobs.selects: depth of the ROW_MAJOR stick staging CBs (reader<->tilize overlap)

knobs.name: CB_DEPTH_CANDIDATES
knobs.selects: ordered depth candidates the RESIDENT search walks for cb_input_tiles / cb_output_tiles, coarsest first

knobs.selects: cores along `width` on an INTERLEAVED input: 0 = AUTO policy, >=1 forces the group size (1 = off)

knobs.name: WIDTH_SPLIT_MIN_WT_PER_CORE
knobs.selects: smallest number of width TILES the AUTO width split may leave a core

knobs.name: WIDTH_SPLIT_MAX_GROUP_CORES

knobs.name: WIDTH_SPLIT_MIN_GAIN

knobs.name: REDUCE_ACC_VIA_ADD_MIN_CHUNK_WT

knobs.name: REDUCE_ACC_VIA_ADD_MIN_CALL_WT

knobs.name: COMBINE_TREE_F0

audits.detail: cb_scaler is allocated scaler_pages = 2 whenever kernel_partial_w != 0, but the live set is scaler_tiles = 1 on the AccumulateViaAdd datapath (its partial-W mechanism is a single 0/1 mask tile, not the [full, partial] scaler pair). The host asserts scaler_tiles <= scaler_pages and never shrinks the allocation. Observed at c06 (PARTIAL_W=8, REDUCE_ACC_VIA_ADD=1, cb_scaler 2 pages / 4096 B, SCALER_TILES=1): one 2048-byte page per core is allocated and never pushed. No reason is recorded at the site.

cb_row_final is CB_ROW_STAT_DEPTH * block_rows pages against a live set of block_rows. cb_row_stat's 2x has a recorded CORRECTNESS reason (D6, ring rotation) and cb_sum_handoff's has a recorded PIPELINE reason (D25); cb_row_final reuses the same constant with no reason of its own recorded. At c20 (block_rows 20) that is 20 spare fp32 pages = 81920 B per core on 64 cores.

No CB whose axis accounting says `spans` an axis fails to scale with it. The two that look collapsed are documented: cb_x_squared spans width at x_squared_wt (== 1 only under the DEST fold, where the live set genuinely is one tile), and cb_stat_handoff / cb_compact_handoff / cb_mcast_in are FLAT in block_rows because D27's compact tile carries all block_rows stats in its columns.

cb_row_stat, cb_sum_handoff, cb_partials_gathered, cb_stat_handoff, cb_row_final, cb_gather_l1 and cb_node_out are Float32 on EVERY build, including the ELEVEN cases with fp32_dest_acc_en == False (c10, c11, c12, c13, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, c24, c25). Reasons ARE recorded -- D5 for cb_row_stat (it is the cross-chunk accumulator that reduce()'s Accumulate reloads, so fp32 keeps the STREAM reload lossless even when DEST is 16-bit) and D11 for the combine chain (the cross-core sum is itself an fp32 elementwise add) -- but the reference's audit-2 `over` direction is stated as a finding no stated reason rescues, so it is recorded as one here rather than adjudicated.

cb_x_squared and cb_normalized are pure INTERMEDIATES (no user tensor corresponds to them) yet carry the INPUT dtype -- 16-bit at bfloat16/bfloat8_b -- on the FOURTEEN cases with fp32_dest_acc_en == True (c01-c09 and c14-c18; thirteen of them also carry gamma, which is where the earlier count of eleven came from). The audit's `under` direction calls a 16-bit page under fp32 DEST a correctness finding: the x^2 values and the normalized values are truncated to 16 bits at those phase boundaries. The recorded rule (D5) is that every CB declares data_format = the dtype of the tensor it carries; for an intermediate that rule picks the input dtype by convention, not by a precision argument.

There is no ledger in the tree at all (no l1_ledger.md for any op), so no CB carries a `Shares with / why not` cell. Three pairs have plainly disjoint lifetimes and identical page formats with no recorded sharing decision: (cb_x_squared, cb_normalized) -- pass A vs pass B, both the input dtype; (cb_input_sticks, cb_output_sticks) -- pass A staging vs pass B staging, both a tile of the input/output dtype; (cb_gamma_sticks, cb_input_sticks) on the RM path when X_RESIDENT, since cb_gamma_sticks is consumed once at boot. D25's pipeline (block blk+1's pass A issued before block blk's combine) would foreclose the first pair, but that pipeline is carved out to native_in only, so it does not cover the interleaved builds.

Every capacity is closed-form in the 13 symbols of the symbol table plus five named depth constants; every symbol has a bound and the predicate establishing it. Six of them are produced by a bounded search rather than a formula (_solve_blocking at rms_norm_program_descriptor.py:1883, _combine_tree_arity at rms_norm_program_descriptor.py:1013) and are recorded as such with an evaluation table over 25 cases. The one bound that is not stated at its own site is group_size on a SHARDED input: it is the shard grid's core count, bounded only by the device grid, and the flat cb_partials_gathered ring is linear in it -- the slot tree caps the RING at f0 = 4 above deleted >= 18, which bounds a FLAT ring at group_size <= 29 (30 pages) BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by declaration: at group_size 29, f1 = ceil(29/4) = 8 and deleted = 29 - 4 - 8 = 17, one short of the threshold, so the flat path survives; group_size 30 (deleted 18) is the first that takes the tree. 28 (c22) is the observed maximum, not the constructed one.

design_record.decided: RESOLVED by Refinement 1b; the op still passes ReduceFp32Mode::Fast

design_record.subject: the regime predicate SEARCHES the depth knob instead of fixing it
design_record.decided: walk CB_DEPTH_CANDIDATES coarsest-first, take RESIDENT at the first depth that fits; shipped (2,) is byte-identical to a fixed-depth predicate
design_record.measured: depth (2,1) vs (2,): (1,1,32,4032) 38399 -> 46136 ns = 0.83x REGRESSION; three other shapes 0.99x-1.00x

design_record.subject: per-CB data_format = the dtype of the tensor it carries
design_record.decided: bfloat8_b needed no new format machinery; cb_row_stat stays fp32 in BOTH fp32_dest_acc_en modes; unpack_to_dest_mode left entirely at Default (no CB qualifies)

design_record.subject: cb_row_stat is CB_ROW_STAT_DEPTH (=2) * BLOCK_ROWS pages
design_record.decided: a CORRECTNESS requirement, not a perf depth: transform_in_place ROTATES the ring, so a PARTIAL final row-block's finalized tiles straddle the wrap at depth 1
design_record.measured: symptom without it: PCC 0.55-0.93, the 2nd..last row of each partial block garbage; invisible to Phase 0 because every Phase-0 golden cell had block_rows == 1

design_record.subject: ReduceAlgorithm::AccumulateViaAdd above REDUCE_ACC_VIA_ADD_MIN_WT
design_record.decided: a crossover, not unconditional; BOTH datapaths stay live and covered
design_record.measured: whole-op 1.00x-1.06x at four shapes; isolated reduce 0.67x at R=1 rising to 5.35x at R=32. The gap is the finding: rms_norm is dataflow-bound at these widths.

design_record.subject: D7's crossover is measured against wt_per_core, not wt_chunk
design_record.decided: gate on the core's WHOLE reduce dim, since the precision motive scales with the total
design_record.measured: a HEIGHT-sharded (1,1,160,11008) squeezed WT_CHUNK to 2, dropped below the threshold and brought rms 0.127 back

design_record.subject: Refinement 2's placement layer
design_record.decided: the compute kernel's phase sequence, every helper call, the knob set and the L1 predicate are UNCHANGED by sharding; a sharded build differs only in who fills cb_input_tiles, which CB pass B reads the stat from, and whether the finalize is local or on a root

design_record.subject: the ROW_MAJOR BAND scheme (_plan_band)
design_record.decided: an RM width shard's page is a row SEGMENT, but the combine sums per-row PARTIALS elementwise and never needs a whole width tile; each core reduces the band it holds, staged from its own L1 in the tensor's GLOBAL TILE FRAME; PARTIAL_W is passed to the kernels as 0 and the zeroed staging ring REPLACES the reduce mask
design_record.measured: (1,1,224,3072) WIDTH TILE 133224 vs RM BAND 136856 ns (+2.7%); BLOCK +21%; (1,1,256,512) +233% -- the last is a placement cost the caller chose (an RM granule cuts W=512 into 64 slices where TILE cuts 16), not the band

design_record.subject: GRID_W turned from 1 to an AUTO policy (_auto_width_split)
design_record.decided: a decode profile (Rt=1) runs an arbitrarily wide tensor through ONE core; splitting width is the only axis left. Two topologies: a gw x gh rectangle, or a PACKED single group over a bounding box with INACTIVE fillers.
design_record.measured: group size sweep on (1,1,32,7168): 41779 / 13926 / 12876 / 14224 / 19338 ns at gw 1/8/16/32/56. Whole-op 1.00x-3.46x over 13 shapes. WIDTH_SPLIT_MIN_GAIN=4 keeps three grid-filling shapes byte-identical; at MIN_GAIN=2 (1024,1024) regressed 0.92x.

design_record.subject: pass A's square folds width tiles into DEST (DestAccumulation::PerRow) below DEST_ACC_SQUARE_MAX_WT
design_record.decided: a CEILING, not a floor -- the fold accumulates SERIALLY in a DEST word that is 16-bit at fp32_dest_acc_en=False. Gated on PARTIAL_W == 0.

design_record.subject: GATHER_FACES -- how many of a partial tile's four faces the gather ships
design_record.decided: SCOPED by D27 to the block_rows == 1 branch, not retired
design_record.measured: whole-tile ship at block_rows==1 regressed four WIDTH geometries 0.86x-0.98x, MONOTONE in group_size; and the gather was never byte-bound (halving bytes moved the 64-core BLOCK shard ~5%)

design_record.subject: ROW_RESIDENT -- the op's THIRD compute regime (X_RESIDENT decoupled from num_w_chunks == 1)
design_record.decided: hold ONE tile-row of x and the whole row of gamma, chunk only the DERIVED CBs; no second code path (the held CBs are indexed at a TileOffset). GATED ON THE DEPTH SACRIFICE, not on the regime.

design_record.subject: the finalize's rsqrt scoped to the tile faces pass B reads (RSQRT_COL_SCOPE)
design_record.decided: superseded by D17, which extends the scope to the WHOLE finalize chain and deletes the selector
design_record.measured: RC vs C: 1.03x-1.14x over five geometries. THIS is what the sharded geometries were spending time on -- the root runs one transform_in_place per tile-row per round with a group_size-wide fan-out of waiters behind it.

design_record.subject: ROOT_FOLD_OUT -- the root fold's packer-L1-accumulation output spec
design_record.decided: DELETED by D22
design_record.measured: D22 measured 2.18x AND better rel-RMS (2.42e-3 vs 3.38e-3), which REFUTES D16's recorded reasoning

design_record.subject: the whole finalize chain scoped to VectorMode::C in two DEST passes instead of three
design_record.decided: the only path; the whole-tile spelling and its selector (compute CT arg 16) are gone
design_record.measured: 600.7 -> 244.5 ns MATH-thread per finalize call, 2.04x on the stage; and an isolated bench poisoned columns 1..31 five orders of magnitude wrong and still passed the PCC gate

design_record.subject: on the COMBINE path pass A's reduce packs its partial STRAIGHT into cb_sum_handoff
design_record.decided: deletes the fp32 tile copy that used to move cb_row_stat -> cb_sum_handoff on EVERY core of EVERY group; legal because the combine path takes its slice in ONE chunk
design_record.measured: the compute_partial_handoff zone is 'retired with the copy it measured'

design_record.subject: a separate finalize chain that unpacked cb_row_stat and packed cb_stat_handoff
design_record.decided: DELETED by D22's fused root chain
design_record.measured: see D22

design_record.subject: the reduce datapath's THIRD floor, on the reduce's actual PER-CALL width (x_squared_wt)
design_record.decided: spelled as a narrow carve-out BELOW D7/D8's two floors, which both stay load-bearing
design_record.measured: per-call width 1: ReduceTile 2.75x faster at BETTER rel-RMS. Whole pass A 11551 -> 6079 ns (1.90x), rel-RMS 0.00491 -> 0.00459. Getting the polarity backwards was measured twice: replacing MIN_CHUNK_WT regressed (1,1,160,11008) to 0.04774; vetoing on num_w_chunks>1 regressed (1,1,32,4064) RM to 0.06093.

design_record.subject: pass B's DEST-LANE BLOCK SIZE (PASS_B_BLK, a divisor of WT_CHUNK capped by DEST_AUTO_LIMIT) plus its PerChunk pack lifecycle
design_record.decided: adopted
design_record.measured: 14050 -> 8860 ns (1.59x), BITWISE identical. The assigned fusion of pass B's two multiplies was a measured REGRESSION (0.84x) and is NOT here.

design_record.subject: the FUSED ROOT CHAIN -- the group fold accumulates PAIRWISE IN DEST and the finalize runs in that same DEST window, one pack
design_record.decided: replaces D16 and D19; every COMBINE-path use of cb_row_stat is deleted; needs GATHER_SLOTS (group_size rounded up to even) so the pairwise walk is universal
design_record.measured: stage pair 5874 -> 2698 ns (2.18x) and MORE accurate (rel-RMS 2.42e-3 vs 3.38e-3). The pad-free alternative (seed DEST with a copy_tile) was built and LOST: 4442 -> 4610 ns (0.964x).

design_record.subject: TILE-gamma read granularity (gamma_trim)
design_record.decided: fetch only the face-rows pass B's BroadcastDim::Row consumer reads; bfloat8_b demotes to a half page (272-byte face is not 64-B aligned) -- a FORMAT fact, not a shape guard
design_record.measured: interleaved prefill 1.10x-1.18x, BIT-EXACT across 7 geometries x 3 gamma dtypes; captures 83% of gamma's marginal read cost (the hard ceiling, deleting gamma outright, is 82785 ns vs 90338)

design_record.subject: the root publishes its OWN stat copy BEFORE the broadcast
design_record.decided: adopted; also makes Mcast1D's sender-excluding rect and Mcast2D's sender-including rect behave identically
design_record.measured: -2643 ns on the root (compute_scale 13575 -> 10932)

design_record.subject: the COMBINE PIPELINE -- block blk+1's pass A issued before block blk's combine, plus cb_sum_handoff at depth 2
design_record.decided: carved out to native_in: on a reader-fed input ring the pipeline is INCORRECT (a tile offset cannot cross a ring wrap) and, once made correct, still 0.894x. The gather ring stays at ONE round.
design_record.measured: fills the root's ~3400 ns/round arrival idle; 1.161x with the depth-2 handoff vs 1.135x without. Deepening the gather ring was a regression twice over.

design_record.subject: the gather's per-face boot zeroing, DELETED on the identity path
design_record.decided: deleted; only the odd-group pad page is still zeroed
design_record.measured: a bench seeded faces 1/3 with NINE catastrophic patterns (1e30, -1e30, NaN, +-Inf, fp32 subnormals, an Inf+(-Inf)=NaN mix, a stale-L1 lookalike) at group sizes 4/8/9/28/32 and got output BIT-IDENTICAL (torch.equal) to the zeroed run every time

design_record.subject: THE COMPACT PARTIAL TRANSPOSE -- the combine's per-round unit becomes ONE tile whose columns 0..block_rows-1 are the block's stats
design_record.decided: cb_partials_gathered goes GATHER_SLOTS*block_rows -> GATHER_SLOTS; cb_stat_handoff / cb_compact_handoff / cb_mcast_in become flat in block_rows; cb_bank is new; cb_row_stat is NOT ALLOCATED on the combine path. Carved out at block_rows == 1, where both permutes are the identity.
design_record.measured: the flat ring was 1152 kB at block_rows 32 / group_size 8 (an L1 OOM). block_rows 8->20 (4 rounds -> 2) measured 25761 -> 24164 ns (1.066x); block_rows 32 (1 round) is L1 INFEASIBLE. The identity carve-out: leaving the permutes uniform regressed four WIDTH geometries 0.76-0.80x.

design_record.subject: THE COMBINE'S SLOT TREE, at wide groups only
design_record.decided: two levels, full stop (3 and 4 levels lost at 6 of 7 cells). One arrival semaphore PER LEVEL. Gated on the DERIVED quantity (deleted fold tiles), blind to shape/dtype/placement.
design_record.measured: isolated 1.40x-1.45x; whole-op bracket ADJACENT: deleted 17 = 0.972x REGRESSION, deleted 18 = 1.028x WIN, deleted 20 = 1.074x. L1 goes DOWN (32 -> 14 fp32 pages at group_size 32).
